import csv
from collections import defaultdict

ts = {
 "AHU01":"4693f367-6f23-5b26-868f-f17e866f28b6",
 "CondPump02":"7c6fe42d-3c16-55d2-b72a-7bab085d5a60",
 "HWPump01":"54bac0b6-bd85-5aca-861a-0399d378e5cc",
}

# load values
data = defaultdict(list)
with open(VALUES_CSV) as f:
    r = csv.reader(f)
    header = next(r)
    for row in r:
        tid = row[0]
        if tid in ts.values():
            data[tid].append((row[1], float(row[2])))

for name, tid in ts.items():
    rows = data.get(tid, [])
    overall_max = max(v for _,v in rows)
    day_max = max((v for t,v in rows if t.startswith("2018-10-18")), default=None)
    if day_max is None:
        print(name, "no data that day")
        continue
    print(name, "overall_max", overall_max, "day_max", day_max, "ratio", day_max/overall_max)
